name: LENA
about: A contestant on a game show who is being offered money for her fiancé Mark and wants to know what he is really worth.

name: HOST
about: The game show's host, who controls the price and the tape and enjoys withholding what he knows.

name: MARK
about: Lena's partner, who planned to propose to her in order to get on the show and sell her.

name: BARRY
about: Mark's friend, who urges him to propose so that she will fetch a higher price.

title: What Is He Worth
synopsis: On the show, Lena is offered a price for Mark and chooses to play a tape that will move it.
reason: A conflict over Lena's goal of cashing in Mark, with the Host controlling the terms.

subject: LENA
reason: She already holds it when she comes into play on the show, and nothing shows that Mark knows she is there selling him.
The sequence opens with the Host holding the power: he knows what is on the tape and which way the price will move.

title: Cash Her In
synopsis: Weeks earlier, on a security camera, Barry urges Mark to propose to Lena so he can sell her on the show, and Mark agrees.
reason: The creation of Mark's goal to cash in Lena, a conflict the studio sequence was not about.

text: Barry pitches the plan to Mark
reason: The sequence opens with the two men in agreement and their target absent, so nobody clearly has the upper hand.

subject: MARK
reason: He takes on Barry's plan here, in a private conversation Lena was not part of.
The story returns to Lena and the Host with her goal of cashing in Mark still unresolved.

text: Lena has seen what he planned
reason: A new beat on the resume: Lena now knows Mark meant to sell her, and the Host still controls the price.
Lena has watched the record of his plan, so the object of the goal now knows.
The power shifts against Lena: what she came to sell is losing its value in front of her.

summary: On a game show, the HOST offers LENA forty-five thousand for MARK or the chance to play a tape that will move the price. She plays it. The tape, from a security camera weeks earlier, shows BARRY telling Mark a fiancée is worth ten times a girlfriend, and Mark agreeing to propose, get on the show and cash Lena in. Back in the studio Lena has not moved, and Mark's price falls and keeps falling. Lena wants to cash in Mark; Mark is not shown to know. Mark wants to cash in Lena; she now knows, having seen the tape. Neither goal is resolved: no sale has been made and Lena has not reacted.
